name: @antinna/types-blogger-react
description: DRY and decoupled types for blogger-theme supporting React alignment

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); fs.copyFileSync(path.join('src', 'globals.d.ts'), path.join('dist', 'globals.d.ts')); const indexPath = path.join('dist', 'index.d.ts'); const d = fs.readFileSync(indexPath, 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync(indexPath, '/// <reference path=\"./globals.d.ts\" />\n' + d);"
